country.name: Burkina Faso
country.jurisdictionNotice: Basic education, literacy and national-language promotion; secondary and technical/vocational education; and higher education are currently assigned to separate ministries. BRASA must attach every claim to the competent ministry, territorial authority, institution and effective period.
country.languagePolicy: French and Burkina Faso's national languages have distinct official, instructional, literacy and community roles. Mooré, Dioula, Fulfuldé and other languages or varieties must not be collapsed into one generic national-language option or treated as reviewed localization without competent curriculum and community review.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Burkinabè reviewer, current authoritative evidence and review by the responsible ministry, territorial service, institution, CIL or child-protection authority.

governanceModel.summary: The 2026 education sector is divided among the ministry responsible for basic education, literacy and national languages, the ministry responsible for secondary and technical/vocational education, and the ministry responsible for higher education and research. Statistical, school-recognition, curriculum, examination and authorization records must remain within their exact subsector and period.
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve institution name, region, province, commune, locality, sector, level or cycle, public/private status, recognition or authorization evidence, source school year and current operating status. Examination-result pages and aggregate statistics are not school authorization records.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Institution creation, authorization to open, authorization to recruit and train in a named academic year, exact regularly opened programme, monitoring classification, closure or reopening decision, diploma authority and professional recognition are separate claims.

authorities.name: Ministry responsible for Basic Education, Literacy and Promotion of National Languages (MEBAPLN)
authorities.role: preschool, primary, literacy, non-formal education and national-language promotion within its current mandate

authorities.name: Regional, provincial and basic-education district services
authorities.role: territorial education administration, records and statistical chain within assigned competence

authorities.name: Ministry responsible for Secondary Education and Technical and Vocational Training (MESFPT)
authorities.role: secondary education and technical/vocational education and training within its current mandate

authorities.name: Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation (MESRI)
authorities.role: higher-education governance, public institutions and private-institution authorization and monitoring

authorities.name: DGESS and competent sector statistical services
authorities.role: annual education statistics by subsector and school year

authorities.name: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie
Commission de l'informatique et des libertés
authorities.role: personal-data protection authority under Law No. 001-2021/AN

authorities.name: Ministry and justice or social-action authorities competent for child protection
authorities.role: implementation of child-protection law and safeguarding procedures

curriculum.authority: The competent education ministry and curriculum structure according to level, cycle and programme
curriculum.title: Official Burkina Faso programmes, teacher guides and curriculum texts
curriculum.implementationRule: Confirm ministry, subsector, level, cycle, class, subject or trade, programme or guide type, approving text, edition, publication date, effective school year and current implementation guidance. A sector plan, reform announcement, digitization project or pilot is not proof of the controlling current curriculum for every school.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: Law, official programme, teacher guide, pupil material, examination syllabus, bilingual-primary guide, technical reference framework, reform project and external resource are different layers and must not silently replace one another.

schoolDirectory.authority: Competent education ministry and its regional, provincial, communal or district services according to subsector
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: The ministry launched a georeferenced census intended to support an exhaustive directory, and official annual statistics and dated lists contain institution evidence. A current public interface or downloadable unified national school-level directory covering every preschool, primary, secondary, technical, vocational, public, private, literacy and non-formal structure was not verified. Dated recognized-private-school lists and annual statistical establishments must retain their school year and cannot silently prove current operation.
requiredRecordFields: source school year or publication date

educationStatistics.authority: DGESS, competent sector statistical services and INSD within their respective mandates
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: Every figure must preserve subsector, observation or academic year, publication date, definition, public/private coverage, region or national geography and displacement or accessibility limitations where applicable. A publication released in 2025 about academic year 2023–2024 is not 2025 enrollment data.

higherEducationAndTVET.authority: MESRI and the competent secondary/TVET ministry within their respective mandates
higherEducationAndTVET.authorityNotice: A list authorizing a private higher-education institution to recruit and train for one academic year applies only to the named institution, site and regularly opened programmes shown for that period. A monitoring classification is not automatic authorization or accreditation; closure, summons, reopening and later regulatory decisions can change status. Verify the exact programme, academic year, site, mode, decision and professional recognition separately.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Law No. 001-2021/AN of 30 March 2021 on protection of persons regarding processing of personal data
privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionAuthority: Commission de l'informatique et des libertés (CIL)
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenLaw: Law No. 015-2014/AN of 13 May 2014 on protection of children in conflict with the law or in danger
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Lawful basis or consent and exceptions, prior declaration or authorization when applicable, sensitive and biometric data, transparency, purpose limitation, security, retention, access rights, international transfers, learner images, child participation, safeguarding, referral and incident reporting require qualified current review before real learner participation. Citation of the child-protection law through another official legal text is not a substitute for verifying the current consolidated child-protection text and implementing procedures.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: French, Mooré, Dioula, Fulfuldé and Burkina Faso's other national languages have distinct instructional, literacy, assessment and community roles. Bilingual-primary resources are level- and model-specific. Preserve the exact language or variety, orthography, region or community, level, approved material, accessibility requirement and qualified community review.

completionCriteria: A qualified Burkinabè education reviewer is named.
Basic, secondary, TVET, territorial, higher-education, statistical, privacy and child-protection responsibilities are correctly assigned.
A verified unified current public school-directory source is documented or the directory gap remains visibly disclosed.
Every school record preserves region, province, commune, locality, subsector, recognition evidence, status, school year and review date.
Every statistic preserves observation or academic year separately from publication date, together with definition, coverage and geography.
Curriculum mappings preserve ministry, subsector, level, cycle, class or trade, subject, language, text, edition and effective year.
Every higher-education or TVET claim separately verifies institution, exact programme, authorization, academic year, site, mode, monitoring or accreditation decision and professional recognition.
French and each national language are represented according to their distinct instructional and community context.
Privacy, child-protection, accessibility, safeguarding, low-bandwidth, offline and incident procedures are approved before a real learner pilot.
No authorization, recognition, accreditation, partnership or credential claim exceeds documentary evidence.
